_about: CLIPBUILD clip_build.json: single source of truth for character clip builds (Tools/clip_build.py + Assets/Editor/CharacterClipBuild.cs). Every base state is built from a RAW Mixamo library clip onto the roster character own skeleton. No character is named in code: ids come from roster.json; characters{} only holds per-character overrides. A tuning profile is legal only for its owner (Joan profile = zero offsets = raw Mixamo; the Dracula crimson_v5 profile cannot be used by anyone else). Rows with "foreign" are explicit exceptions with a reason. attacks/dodges/finishers sets are listed under delegated and keep running through bake_attack_clips.py / bake_dodge_clips.py / FinisherClipSetup until merged.
skipReason: Pitborn keeps his legacy clips until reviewed: his body is not Mixamo-native (HC2) and his missing attack rows will come from the combat_clips_unity pack through enemyPackHook. Remove him from skipIds to build him (raw Mixamo, waiver gates).

legFix.note: auto = only clips whose inward knee offset exceeds the trigger are fixed (raw loops stay raw); always | auto | off

enemyPackHook._about: HOOK ONLY (Strategy 2026-11-05): kits_out/3d/combat_clips_unity (OpenTrident handoff: Dracula + Pitborn, 52 bones, Hips translation in every clip, loop flags unreliable, attacks travel 1-3.7 m). The Pitborn enemy row may later list sources from it: set enabled true and add rows with src "enemyPack:<file>" under characters.Pitborn.extraRows. clip_build.py refuses an enemyPack source for any id not in allowedFor, so it can never reach Joan.

controllerTemplate.note: null-motion template for CharacterClipBuild.cs (Unity side): every state of this controller is created with motion = null and filled from the character own combat glb. Dracula.controller is NOT a template any more.

guard.note: mask built from the character own root (glb root node, Armature for Joan) and assigned to roster.guardMask

delegated.finishers: FinisherClipSetup.cs (raw Mixamo finisher sources; NOT on the 106 rig yet, see gates.rigAudit)

sword.note: approximation: blade axis = forearm direction (weapon_grip.json Joan row: the blade follows the forearm), segment from hand-tang to hand+blade, head = sphere at the Head bone + up
